info.title: FluentCRM API
info.description: Complete REST API documentation for FluentCRM — a self-hosted email marketing and CRM plugin for WordPress.

get.description:
Retrieve the current FluentCRM Pro license status. The license key is partially masked for security (first 4 and last 4 characters visible). If the license is expired, a renewal URL is included.

<!-- fc:access -->

**Required capability:** `fcrm_manage_settings`

_Enforced by `SettingsPolicy::verifyRequest()`, the policy default for this route group._

**Requires:** FluentCampaign Pro. Without it the route does not exist.

<!-- /fc:access -->

license_key.description: Masked license key (first and last 4 characters visible). `activation_hash` is never returned.

renew_url.description: URL to renew the license. Present when status is 'expired' or 'valid'.

error.description: Present and true if there was an error checking license status. Present **only** when the licence check failed; absent on a valid licence.

variation_id.description: Identifier of the purchased licence variation.

variation_title.description: Human-readable licence tier, e.g. `50 Sites Lifetime License`.

expires.description: Expiry date, or `lifetime` for a perpetual licence.

account_url.description: URL of the customer's account area on the licensing store.

license_key_masked.description: Masked license key (first and last 4 characters visible). Same value as `license_key`.

product_title.description: Product name shown on the license screen.

expires_human.description: Expiry date formatted with the site's date format. Empty string for lifetime licenses or when no expiry date is known.

days_remaining.description: Whole days until expiry (negative once expired). null for lifetime licenses or when no expiry date is known.

in_grace_period.description: True when the license has expired but is still inside the post-expiry grace period.

grace_period_days.description: Length of the grace period in days. null unless an expiry date is known and a grace period applies.

last_checked_human.description: Relative time of the last remote license check, e.g. `5 mins ago`. Empty string if never checked.
